text: Dmitri is off dairy now, doctor's orders. Oat milk only if he comes round for coffee.
Zoe's dad had a fall on Sunday and broke his wrist. He's home now but she's driving up to help out sometime next week.
Remind me to text Valentina the day before her endoscopy on Thursday at 10am. She's quite nervous about it.
Jen mentioned she's gone vegan since January. Her partner Hugo hasn't, so dinner at theirs is always two menus.
Tamar's little boy has chickenpox. They've cancelled his birthday party on Saturday, so no need to buy anything yet.
Yaw only drinks Guinness. Worth knowing for the barbecue.

Lunch with Yuki and Samir. Yuki is coeliac, properly strict about it, so the Italian place is out. Samir suggested the Lebanese place on Mill Road instead, which apparently does a separate gluten-free menu. Yuki also mentioned her mum was diagnosed coeliac last year too, so they cook gluten-free at home for everyone now. Booked for Thursday at 1pm.
Need to pick up a prescription and cat food before Friday at 5pm.
Mila said her mum's been in hospital since the weekend with pneumonia. She sounded exhausted. I should call her tomorrow evening to see how things are.
Kavya is allergic to tree nuts. Not peanuts, just tree nuts. Carries an EpiPen.
Gintaras has his knee operation on the 14th at half 8. Don't forget to message him that evening to see how it went.

Krisztina and Bogdan are hosting a wine tasting at theirs at the end of the month. Bogdan's really into natural wines at the moment. Krisztina warned me half the guests are vegetarian and one is allergic to shellfish, so I offered to bring a cheese board. I'm bringing Keisha as my plus one.

Claire's daughter Ana has been off school all week with a horrible stomach bug. Claire's working from home to look after her, and her husband has taken Friday off. Ana is meant to be in the school play early next month, so they're hoping she's better in time for rehearsals. Claire seemed frazzled.
Joseph doesn't eat pork and prefers halal. Also not a fan of spicy food, which surprised me.

Chatted with Chidi after church. His wife Hadiza is expecting their second in early March! They found out the gender but aren't telling anyone. Hadiza's had terrible morning sickness this time round and can barely keep anything down except ginger biscuits. Their eldest, Tomás, starts reception in September. I should drop off some ginger tea for her sometime this week.

Manon twisted her ankle at netball last night. She's on crutches for at least two weeks and has had to pull out of the 10k on the 2nd. She'd been training since the summer and is gutted. Her physio appointment is on Monday at 4:15. Remind me to message her on Monday evening to ask what the physio said.
Remind me to send Tomás the recipe for the lamb tagine. He loved it.
Irina's off caffeine because of her migraines. Decaf or peppermint tea.

Pieter called. His dad's been diagnosed with Parkinson's. They have a consultant appointment on Tuesday at 2pm to talk about treatment. He's trying to stay positive but he's clearly struggling. I need to check in with him the day after the appointment, and maybe offer to take him out for a pint at the weekend.
Lena's birthday is on the 29th. She keeps saying she wants a proper espresso machine. Hint taken.
Alejandro has started keto and is very evangelical about it. Avoid bringing up bread.
Dimitri (not Dmitri!) is doing Dry January again, starting in two months. Keisha's joining him this year.
Ali's mum is having a hip replacement sometime over the summer. Waiting list date not confirmed yet.
Darius has had a cold for about a week and lost his voice. Rehearsal tomorrow morning is going ahead without him.
Message from Hadiza: Chidi's back went on Monday and he can barely walk. Physio booked for Wednesday at 4pm.
I'm doing the dessert for Jen's dinner party on Saturday at 7. Jen said no nuts because of Kavya.
Should ring Mohammed Ahmed tomorrow morning about the catering. He said his brother Samir can do a halal menu for up to forty people.
Valentina loves very dry white wine, Albariño especially. Hates anything sweet.
Yuki's cat Miso has to have teeth out at the vet on Monday. She's worried because Miso is fifteen.
Follow up with Zoe about her dad's wrist. The cast was meant to come off yesterday.
Groceries for the week: gluten-free pasta, lactose-free milk, lemons. Gym Thursday at 6.
Tamar's son Yaw is much better now, back at nursery on Monday. The party has been rescheduled to the 22nd at 2pm.

Ran into Hugo Schmidt at the station. He's been off work with shingles for three weeks and is going back next Monday, part time to begin with. Said the worst bit was the nerve pain at night. Remind me to text him on Monday morning to wish him luck with the first day back.
Krisztina's husband is gluten intolerant and she's lactose intolerant, so their fridge is a minefield. She said a good box of dark chocolate would go down well for her birthday.
Gintaras said his surgery went fine. Off work until mid-November. His sister Irina is staying to help him.
Mila's mum was discharged this morning. Mila sounded so relieved. I should drop round some soup at the weekend.
Kavya's son has his tonsils out on the 3rd at 9am. She's dreading it more than he is. Must remember to text her that afternoon.
Chidi only drinks rooibos tea. No milk, no sugar.
Note to self: dentist on Wednesday at 11:15, then pick up the dry cleaning.

Had coffee with Bogdan. He's training for a triathlon in the spring and has gone completely teetotal for it. Very disciplined, eats the same porridge every morning. His race is the Windsor one in early June. He also mentioned his son Darius has been poorly with tonsillitis on and off since September and might need them out. Bogdan seemed quite worried about it.
Keisha said her grandmother passed away last week. The funeral is on Friday at 1pm in Leeds. Don't forget to send flowers the day before.
Manon's dad has gout again. She said he refuses to give up red meat and port, so it keeps coming back.
Samir's daughter broke her arm falling off a trampoline. Cast for six weeks, which wrecks their plans to go swimming over half term.
Pieter texted that the consultant was reassuring and his dad is starting new medication next week. I should message him at the weekend.
Ana is pescatarian, but eats chicken occasionally if she's at someone's house. Doesn't like mushrooms at all. Her brother Ali is the opposite, eats anything as long as it's spicy.

Spoke to Lena about Claire. Claire's been signed off with stress for a month. Lena thinks we should take her out for a quiet dinner sometime next week, somewhere low-key with vegetarian options since Claire doesn't eat meat.
Darius and his wife are flying to Lisbon on the 8th, evening flight, back the following Sunday. It's their tenth anniversary.
Remind me the week after Tomás's MRI to ask whether he's got results. Scan is on the 17th at 3:30.
Irina's thinking of training as a nutritionist. She's been reading everything about gut health lately.
Mohammed has been fasting for Ramadan. He said breaking the fast with dates and water is a must before anything else.
Yaw's son has asthma and was in A&E on Saturday night. He's fine now but they're seeing the GP tomorrow at 9:40 to review his inhaler.

Called Alejandro. His back surgery has been postponed to early December, which he's annoyed about. He's still in a lot of pain and can't sit for long. Need to visit him one evening next week and bring the board game he likes.
Wedding for Krisztina's cousin has been called off, so the weekend of the 11th is free after all.
Dmitri's wife Lena makes the best borscht. She's offered to teach me in the new year.
Hugo's girlfriend Yuki has a dissertation deadline at the end of the month and is barely sleeping. I should send her a care package of snacks, nothing with sesame because she's allergic.
Valentina said the endoscopy came back clear. Huge relief. Remind me to congratulate her properly on Saturday when we meet for brunch.
Remember to book the restaurant for my own birthday, ideally the 5th at 8pm. Somewhere that does a decent vegan option.
Zoe's nickname at work is Zed. She's Zoe Thomas, the new head of finance. Drinks flat whites, extra hot.

Joseph has come down with flu and his mum Ana is not great either. The family Sunday lunch is cancelled. Need to call him on Sunday afternoon to check they're both okay, and drop off some paracetamol and orange juice on Monday morning if they still feel rough.
Not much to report. Weather was awful and the café ran out of croissants.
